_comment: Batch 3 — Memphis. Ingested 2026-08-04 from the ChatGPT Work nine-stage workbook (generation A: Import Ready / Venues / Evidence). NOT YET IMPORTED.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Memphis, TN-MS-AR MSA COUNTY LIST (Shelby, Fayette, Tipton (TN); DeSoto, Marshall, Tate, Tunica (MS); Crittenden (AR)), not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the MSA counties [Shelby County, Tennessee (relation/1829139), Fayette County, Tennessee (relation/1829178), Tipton County, Tennessee (relation/1828578), DeSoto County, Mississippi (relation/1829177), Marshall County, Mississippi (relation/1829179), Tate County, Mississippi (relation/1833658), Tunica County, Mississippi (relation/1829181), Crittenden County, Arkansas (relation/1818407)], rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg.
msa: Memphis, TN-MS-AR (Shelby, Fayette, Tipton (TN); DeSoto, Marshall, Tate, Tunica (MS); Crittenden (AR) counties)
_workbook_comment: This workbook has NO address_source column at all, so every one of its 21 rows fails the preflight address_source assertion. address_source_default supplies the fallback for this metro only. "manual_research" is the weaker TRUE claim — the address came from directory research; "official_page" would assert it was taken off the controlling entity's own page, which this workbook nowhere states. A per-row value, where one exists, still wins.
_reconcile_comment: One venue matches a dormant source=osm status=draft row already in facility_listings. It is an UPDATE keyed on osm_id, never an INSERT — and it is not optional: the research row generates the slug "bluff-city-pickleball-bartlett-tn", which is exactly the slug the live row already holds, and slug carries a global unique constraint. Without this entry the listings INSERT raises and the whole metro fails mid-run.

reconciles.note: SAME venue as the dormant OSM row. Independent agreement on all three identifying fields: identical name ("Bluff City Pickleball"), identical street address ("2809 Bartlett Boulevard"), same city/state (Bartlett, TN) — and the slug the pipeline generates from the research row is byte-identical to the live row's slug. The OSM row is access_type="unknown"; the reconcile patches it to the research value "membership", sourced to the venue's own booking site. The OSM row also carries metro_area=NULL, so this reconcile is what brings it into the Memphis metro at all — until now it was invisible to the directory. CONFIRMED INDEPENDENTLY BY THE GEOCODE: the research row's own Nominatim lookup resolved to way/739852316 — the very OSM object the live row carries — 1.06 m from the stored coordinate. Identity here rests on an independent lookup agreeing, not on name matching alone. The OSM coordinate is recorded below as the pre-merge snapshot.

The prior block was locked before ADR-16 (coordinate precision 'low' no longer holds a row; it publishes behind an approximate-location label) and ADR-17 (access_type 'unknown' and candidate research_status 'probable' are no longer gate conditions; only duplicate/not_venue/not_pickleball/held block). Every divergence is accounted for by those two ADRs plus the wave-3 audit holds recorded in facility_candidates.reviewer_notes. Not nudged to fit output.
